resources.string:
Tap “Add .jar” to convert a Java mod.

On this device: textures, sounds, models and languages are packed into a Bedrock pack — no server needed.

With a server: Java logic is translated too.
This run produced no porting notes.
Remove “%1$s”? The add-on is deleted from the server too.

You chose server mode, which needs a computer running the conversion server — decompiling a mod requires Java.

Start it with:
 python3 server/modmorpher_server.py

Then enter its address and token in Settings.

Or switch to on-device mode in Settings to convert without any server.

Works on any phone with no setup. Extracts textures, sounds, models and languages into a Bedrock pack. Java code cannot be translated without a computer, so entity behaviour, blocks and items are listed as unfinished in the notes.
Runs the real modmorpher.py on a computer you control, which also translates Java logic. Needs Java 17+ on that machine and the same network as this phone.

The token is printed by the server when it starts, and is also saved on the server at data/token.txt.\n\nThe phone and the computer must be on the same network. Plain http:// is allowed here, so only use this on a network you trust.
